ClarityGrid Accounting & Advisory

Accessibility statement.

ClarityGrid Accounting & Advisory is committed to providing a website that is usable by a broad audience, including people who use assistive technologies.

Our approach

The site uses semantic headings, labeled controls, keyboard-accessible navigation, readable contrast and responsive layouts. Accessibility is reviewed as website features change.

Need assistance?

If you experience difficulty accessing information or completing a form, email office@claritygridaccounting.com. Describe the page and assistance needed. ClarityGrid will make a reasonable effort to provide the information through an accessible method.
